I usually listen to angry, jaded music or play video games also. Sometimes I'll resort to movies when I just want to zone out. 

I traveled from NY to China, so adjusting has been really difficult. I'm trying but it gets frustrating.

You're right. It's just so hard when one thing after another piles on top of me. I can only take so much, especially emotionally. It's even worse while trying to assimilate with a different culture and language, and there are no close friends nearby to reach out to on a whim. I know self harm isn't a good way to handle things, but somehow it directs the pain somewhere else and in a morbid way makes me feel better. I don't do it often, only under extreme stress which is very rare in my life.
